messages:
alex_kim: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's P95 page storm. I captured the initial remediation items in the tracker but want to assign owners/timelines for alert policy changes (thresholds, dedupe, and paging lanes).

maria_chen: Thanks — can you paste the short list here? I can't open the doc from my phone.

alex_kim: Sure, summary: 1) CPU-alert dedupe rule is firing separately across services -> consolidate by host group. 2) Short spikes are paging on 1-min threshold, should move to 5-min for non-prod lanes. 3) Pager routing shows duplicate rotations for infra-oncall and infra-ops -> fix routing policy. 4) Add a cooldown for autoscaling noise (rule autoscale_cooldown).

kevin_o: For (1) and (4) I can take ownership. I'll add the dedupe rule change and the autoscale cooldown config. Target: EOD Thursday.

jessica: I can handle (2) — change the non-prod 1m -> 5m and update the docs. Can we also add an explicit suppression window for deploy windows?

alex_kim: @jessica yes add suppression window doc note. For (3) routing policy, I think we should do a canary: update routing for one service for 48h then roll out. Who can do the routing test?

maria_chen: I can run the canary for the payment-service on Monday. Will monitor metrics and page counts.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3149 linked to thread. Postmortem draft at https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-3149 (editable)

kevin_o: Putting action items in the tracker now:
- action: dedupe-by-host-group, owner: kevin_o, due: 2026-03-26, notes: "merge alerts with label service:infra -> group by hostpool"
- action: autoscale-cooldown, owner: kevin_o, due: 2026-03-26, notes: "add 3m cooldown to scaling rule"

jessica: Added: 
- action: nonprod-thresholds-5m, owner: jessica, due: 2026-03-25, notes: "update rule and doc, add deploy suppression"

alex_kim: I'll own the follow-up to verify paging policy fix and update runbook.

maria_chen: Quick Q: are we comfortable changing 1m -> 5m globally or only for non-prod? I worry about missing real regressions in staging.

jessica: Let's keep it non-prod only. For prod, we'll look at adding a rolling window alert that requires 3/5 windows to be > threshold before page.

alex_kim: Good call. Add that as a follow-up: "prod-windowed-thresholds", owner: alex_kim, due: 2026-04-02.

kevin_o: Small snippet I'll apply for dedupe (in alerting config):
```
matchers: ["service:infra"]
group_by: ["hostpool"]
dedupe_window: 5m
```

maria_chen: Sounds good. After changes, let's run a 72h noise-check: count pages/day and p95 latency. If pages drop > 60% and no regressions, we close.

jessica: Agreed. I'll add a chart to the dashboard and share link here when ready.

alex_kim: One more recurring pattern note from postmortem: midnight autoscaling flaps during backup windows -> capture as "recurring:backup-flap" and set a monthly review to tune backup concurrency. Owner: infra-eng, assignee: maria_chen, due: 2026-04-10.

kevin_o: Acked.

oncall-bot: Action items updated in tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/2026-03-23-sweep

maria_chen: I'll run the canary Monday and post status by EOD Monday. If anything looks off, we roll back immediately.

alex_kim: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop in the postmortem doc once we've got the 72h noise-check. :thumbsup:

jessica: thanks, folks — short and actionable.
